name: CanyonOS
summary: Open-source (AGPL-3.0) platform to write, deploy, scale and observe agentic apps in plain Python, on your laptop, in your AWS account or on Kubernetes.
description: Open-source (AGPL-3.0) platform to write, deploy, scale and observe agentic apps in plain Python, on your laptop, in your AWS account or on Kubernetes.

pricing.details: Free, open source (AGPL-3.0), to run on your own compute (your laptop, your AWS account or Kubernetes). Paid offerings may be added later.
pricing.label: Free

features: Write, deploy, scale and observe agentic apps in plain Python (no SDK/graph required, official)
One-command deploy to your AWS account or Kubernetes; independent scaling
Observability without extra tracing code; any OpenAI-compatible provider
AGPL-3.0, free on your own compute; paid services planned later, no public paid ladder yet
